values.meaning: static cooldown between the initial cast and the recast
values.quote: a {{fd|2.5}}-second {{tt|static cooldown|Unaffected by ability haste}} within 10 seconds of the first activation

mechanics.claim: The recast can be used within 10 seconds of the first activation, on a static 2.5-second cooldown unaffected by ability haste.
mechanics.quote: can be recast after a {{fd|2.5}}-second {{tt|static cooldown|Unaffected by ability haste}} within 10 seconds of the first activation

mechanics.claim: The recast damage scales with the target's missing health up to a cap, reaching 3x the base minimum damage at 70% missing health (the Maximum Magic Damage value).
mechanics.quote: increased by {{as|{{pp|key=%|key1=%|type=target's '''missing''' health|0 to 200 for 11|0 to 70|formula=2.86% per 1% of target's '''missing''' health, capped at 70% '''missing''' health}}|health}}

mechanics.claim: This ability's damage is calculated from the caster's stats at the start of cast and does not change dynamically afterward.
mechanics.quote: This ability's damage is calculated based on the caster's stats at the start of cast and does not change dynamically.

mechanics.claim: An enemy already hit by one cast of Perfect Execution cannot be hit again by the same cast.
mechanics.quote: Enemies already hit by either of ''Perfect Execution's'' casts cannot be affected more than once by the same cast.

mechanics.claim: The ability's cooldown begins only after the full effect (including the recast window) resolves.
Both casts count as ability activations for on-cast effects.
mechanics.quote: Both casts count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.
